newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares up in rebound from Monday's losses.
newsitem.headline: German shares up in rebound from Monday's losses.

text.p: 0655 GMT - German shares up in early IBIS pre-bourse computer dealings in rebound to Monday's losses. DAX index seeks to gain momentum to break 3,800 points as dollar rising above 1.74 marks gives market fuel. Market generally ignores overnight Wall Street losses.
* IBIS DAX up 19.82 points at 3,786.71 points. DAX ended bourse trade on Monday down 9.64 at 3,785.77.
* September DAX futures up 21.5 points at 3,815.5 points.
* Linotype says its shareholders to get 44.04 marks per share from Heidelberger, five Linotype shares to be exchanged for two Heidelberger shares.
